not-provisioned: This window was started without the local server. Run `just start`, or `just server`, which creates the chat credential on first run.
not-ready: The local server is still starting.
not-listening: The local server is not answering. Run `just start`, or `just server`, and try again.
wrong-stage: This window is on stage “{bundle}” and the local server was asked for stage “{requested}”.
wrong-stage-plain: This window and the local server are on different stages.
document-unserved: This window could not load {page}. The dev server is not serving that page.
script-unserved: Could not load {page}. The dev server did not serve {script}.
still-compiling: Still waiting for {page}. The dev server may still be compiling {script}.
